en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3324 - Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Ashyam narrated that

he asked Abu al-Hasan, peace be upon him, about a man whose wife became pure from her menstruation, and he said: "So-and-so is divorced," while people were listening to his words, but he did not tell them, "Bear witness." Does the divorce take effect upon her?
Imam (as) said: "Yes, this is a testimony. Would you leave her in suspense?"
